sloka: ते छिन्न शिरसः पेतुः छिन्न चर्म शरासनाः ।सुपर्ण वात विक्षिप्ता जगत्याम् पादपा यथा ॥३-२५-२९॥
transliteration: te chinna śirasaḥ petuḥ chinna carma śarāsanāḥ ।suparṇa vāta vikṣiptā jagatyām pādapā yathā ॥3-25-29॥

translations.english: The rest of the demons hit by the arrows ran desperate towards Khara for refuge.
